entities.name: Mitochondrial intermediate peptidase
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Homo sapiens UniProt Q99797; 713 aa and 100% query/target coverage.
Annotated as a zinc-dependent mitochondrial matrix metalloendopeptidase, EC 3.4.24.59.
Cleaves imported mitochondrial precursor proteins to their mature size, releasing an N-terminal octapeptide during second-stage processing.
Monomeric enzyme; Peptidase_M3 domain spans residues 255–697 with i-Evalue 4e-146.

entities.name: Zinc ion
observations: UniProt annotation states that mitochondrial intermediate peptidase binds one Zn2+ ion as catalytic cofactor.

entities.name: Mitochondrial precursor octapeptide cleavage
observations: Second-stage mitochondrial protein processing: hydrolytic cleavage of imported precursor proteins to mature forms, with release of an N-terminal octapeptide in characterized substrates.
